about.text: Yak butter is butter made from the milk of the female yak, a staple of Tibet, the Himalaya and Mongolia: eaten with roasted barley flour, churned into butter tea, burned in lamps and modelled into festival sculptures.

facts.v: Yoghurt gathered for several days, poured into an inflated sheep's stomach and shaken until butter forms
Yak milk has nearly twice the fat of whole cow milk
Very creamy yak butter served at yurt camps in the Murghab area of the Pamirs
Yak butter was made in Kathmandu factories for sale; 26 tonnes were sold in 1997–1998
